acceptance: A FAILED platform_result in a TPC-DS throughput stream marks that query failed, the stream unsuccessful, and withholds Throughput@Size/QphDS
A regression test with a real adapter connection (not a mock cursor) executes an invalid query in a TPC-DS throughput stream and asserts queries_failed=1 and success=False
TPC-DS throughput row-count validation under dsqgen stream seeds has an explicit policy (validate, range, or exclude per query) with a test, so the fix does not turn valid runs into false failures
A real TPC-DS SF0.01+ throughput run on DuckDB still completes successfully after the fix
context: Found in the 2026-10-04 adversarial review of the throughput work (develop 8ed0c64e1). Consensus finding from two independent reviewers, both reproduced by script.
description:
`TPCDSThroughputTest._run_single_stream_query` (benchbox/core/tpcds/throughput_test.py:515-530 at develop 8ed0c64e1) returns `cursor.platform_result` and a row count but never checks `platform_result["status"]`. Adapters catch SQL errors and row-count mismatches and return `{"status": "FAILED"}` instead of raising (duckdb.py:1234-1246, sqlite.py, spark_execution_mixin.py, sql_execution.py:171-196). The caller then records `success=True` and increments `queries_successful`. The TPC-H driver raises on FAILED (tpch/throughput_test.py:480-486) and the TPC-DS power test checks it (tpcds/power_test.py:327).

Effect: every TPC-DS throughput stream "succeeds" even when queries fail, Throughput@Size and QphDS are published, exported rows say SUCCESS, and TPC-DS throughput row-count validation has no effect.

Reproduced by two independent reviewers: a PlatformAdapterConnection over DuckDB running `SELECT * FROM no_such_table` gave queries_successful=1, queries_failed=0, success=True.

Fixing this will surface a second problem: stream 0 is validated against reference answer counts, but its parameters come from `dsqgen -RNGSEED 42`, not the reference parameters. Decide how stream-0 validation applies under non-reference seeds (mirror the TPC-H RANGE/exclusion policy) in the same change.
